scope: Additional direct viewing of all three exact fullsize PNGs and their original PNGs resolved previously pending display indices5-7. The original pixels, not filenames, determined mouth and gaze; opaque backdrop and collar remain checked. Only these three sources are selected.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Original has a closed neutral lip with a light rim, not an open toothy smile. Small shaded mascot lip is compatible. Same right-facing raised head, swept parted dark hair, clean face, grey suit and pale patterned tie retained; compact curved chin at white collar.

decisions.reason: Original clean-shaven face and small closed neutral mouth are retained in creature form, with visible grey side hair, eyebrows, decorated dark cap, red embroidered collar and neck cross. No invented moustache, beard or separate yellow neck column.
